title: IT infra firm OGX Group ends ACE Market debut slightly below IPO price
desc:
OGX Group Bhd (KL:OGX) fell 20% on its maiden trading day on the ACE Market amid broader market decline on Thursday.
The counter opened at 28 sen compared to its initial public offering (IPO) price of 35 sen per share. The stock began easing off lows, and was trading at 31 sen at 9.15am after close to 35 million shares changed hands. The last price valued the computer infrastructure company at about RM233 million.
